After discussion,
upon a motion duly made and seconded, the Board voted unanimously to approve the
minutes of the meeting of 27 August 2026, as written.

After discussion, upon a motion duly made and seconded, the Board voted
unanimously to (1) accept the Detention Facilities Report; and (2) authorize Mr. Schuett
to construct the Replacement Section at a cost not to exceed $2,500.00.

Then, after discussion, upon a motion duly made and seconded, the Board voted
unanimously to approve the Tax Assessor/Collector's Report and to authorize payment
of the checks listed therein.

Then, upon a motion duly made and seconded, the Board voted 3 to 0 to authorize
publication of the tax rate calculation showing a debt service rate of $0.266 per $100
valuation and a maintenance tax rate of $0.124 per $100 valuation for a combined tax
rate of $0.39 per $100 valuation.

After discussion, upon a motion duly made and seconded, the Board voted
unanimously to (1) authorize payment of Pay Application No. 3 and FINAL to CFG;
(2) approve Change Order No. 1 and authorize execution of same; and (3) accept the
HPT Addition project and authorize execution of the Certificate of Acceptance.

After discussion, upon a motion duly made and seconded, the Board voted
unanimously to (1) authorize the yield restriction payment to the IRS in the amount of
$12,790.85; and (2) authorize execution and submission of Form 8038-T. A copy of Form
8038-T is attached hereto as an exhibit to these minutes.

Then, after review, upon a motion duly made and seconded, the Board voted
unanimously to accept the Operator's Report, a copy of which is attached hereto.

Then, upon
a motion duly made and seconded, the Board voted unanimously to approve the
Bookkeeper's Report, and to authorize payment of the checks listed therein.
